title: Hermes Auto routing metadata envelope (v1)
description: The private `_hermes_auto` object injected by the Hermes model-provider shim. The gateway strips this object before upstream transmission. Protocol version and property names are closed so a mismatched shim fails explicitly. String lengths are bounded, while values remain opaque because Hermes owns their formats. Validation establishes shape only; the gateway still treats the envelope as untrusted and hashes the root session identifier before retaining an in-memory routing decision.

protocol_version.description: Envelope protocol version. Pinned to 1. Any other value MUST be rejected rather than best-effort parsed.

root_session_id.description: The stable Hermes root session identifier. It crosses the authenticated loopback boundary and is salted and hashed before the router retains decision state.

virtual_model.description: The virtual model requested by the caller, such as `auto`, `auto:balanced`, `auto:quality`, `auto:economy`, or `auto:session`.

plugin_version.description: Version string of the provider plugin that produced this envelope, used for compatibility diagnostics.

auxiliary_task.description: Optional Hermes auxiliary task alias, such as `compression`, `vision`, `title_generation`, or `web_extract`; null or absent for a normal main-provider request.
